name: Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan armed forces (Taliban)

doctrine.summary: The armed forces of the Islamic Emirate, the government the Taliban set up after taking power in August 2021: an army organised into regional corps, the Interior Ministry's police and the GDI intelligence service, plus 'special forces' units such as Badri 313 that show off US-made kit captured from the former Afghan security forces (Humvees, Ford Ranger pickups, MaxxPro MRAPs, M1117s, M4 and M16 rifles, night-vision devices and some Mi-17 and UH-60 helicopters). Most fighters are light infantry veterans of the insurgency: skilled in mountain movement, ambush and endurance, weaker in maintenance, logistics and combined arms. As of 2026 the Emirate is recognised only by Russia (July 2025); most states, the UN and Western governments do not recognise it. It fights ISIS-K inside Afghanistan, and has fought an open border war with Pakistan since February 2026 (Pakistan's 'Operation Ghazab lil-Haq' strikes on alleged TTP and ISIS-K camps; Taliban counter-attacks on border posts; Taliban-claimed air strikes on alleged ISIS-K sites in Pakistan in June 2026).
doctrine.fireteam: Groups of 8-12 under a commander, loosely paired; mounted in Rangers or Humvees; 'special forces' in matched captured US kit.
tactics: Mountain ambushes and movement on foot over ridgelines
Mounted patrols and checkpoints in captured Rangers, Humvees and MRAPs
Night raids on ISIS-K hideouts by 'special forces' units
Border-post fighting against Pakistani forces (artillery, mortars, small arms)
Checkpoint control of roads and towns; search of vehicles

camo.name: Shalwar kameez and patu shawl
camo.use: Most fighters and police; turbans black or white

camo.name: Captured US/ANA camouflage (woodland, MultiCam, ANA pattern)
camo.use: 'Special forces' units such as Badri 313 with helmets, plate carriers and NVGs

grenadier: AK with GP-25 / M4 with M203 (captured)
squad_leader: M4 carbine with optic (captured) or AKM

body_armor.notes: Rank-and-file: none (chest rigs only). 'Special forces' units: captured US helmets and plate carriers (medium, ceramic) and night-vision.

vehicles.notes: Above all the green ex-Afghan-police Ford Ranger pickups, plus Hiluxes (toyota_hilux).
Hilux pickups alongside the ex-police Rangers.
Ex-ANA Humvees (M1151/M1152), many with unit flags.
Pickups with DShK or captured M2.
Land Cruiser pickups and SUVs for commanders.
Ex-ANA MaxxPro MRAPs shown in parades; limited maintenance.
M1117 Guardian armoured security vehicles of the former ANA Mobile Strike Force.
A handful of airworthy ex-Afghan Air Force Mi-17s.
A few ex-Afghan Air Force UH-60A Black Hawks seen flying in 2021-2022; airworthiness doubtful.
Motorbikes for scouts, couriers and village patrols, as during the insurgency.

support_assets: Mortars and a few old artillery pieces (D-30) on the Pakistan border
Small drones (claimed) and a handful of helicopters

as_client: Counter-ISIS-K raid on a cell, safe house or cache (afghan_highlands)
Infrastructure protection (mine, dam, power line or rail project) against ISIS-K attack
as_target: Recover captured US-made equipment or sensitive items before it is sold on
Extract a person at risk (journalist, former interpreter) through Taliban checkpoints
Avoid-contact transit through Taliban territory to reach an ISIS-K target
Third-party fights: Taliban and ISIS-K clash during a player mission

notes: The de facto government of Afghanistan since August 2021; recognised only by Russia (July 2025), with China, Pakistan, Qatar and others hosting Taliban envoys without formal recognition; not recognised by the UN. Kind is non_state because of that limited recognition; this is a description, not a judgement. Situation as of October 2026: fighting an ISIS-K insurgency at home and an open border war with Pakistan (since February 2026) that analysts say benefits ISIS-K; UN monitoring reports describe continuing ties with al-Qaeda figures (afg_taliban -> al_qaeda = +30, game value). Western states keep sanctions and no diplomatic relations. Game (Captain-confirmed (2026-10-10)): a limited client that can hire the player for counter-ISIS-K operations, convoy escort and infrastructure protection, and never sells gear; relations.player is -10. In afghan_highlands the player meets Taliban checkpoints and patrols as an obstacle and as a third party that also fights ISIS-K.
